title: Biocatalyst
description: A biocatalyst is an enzyme or enzyme-containing system used to catalyze biochemical reactions. This section defines the complete characterization of a biocatalyst including its identity, source, application conditions, immobilization status, and storage requirements.

application.title: application
application.description: Details about how the biocatalyst is applied in the reaction, including concentration, activity, and workflow specifics.

identity.title: identity
identity.description: Essential identifying information about the biocatalyst including name, EC number, molecular properties, and sequence data.

immobilization.title: immobilization
immobilization.description: Information about whether and how the biocatalyst is immobilized on a support material.

notes.title: notes
notes.description: Additional notes or comments about the biocatalyst that don't fit in other categories.

source.title: source
source.description: Information about how the biocatalyst was obtained, whether purchased commercially or produced in-house.

storage.title: storage
storage.description: Conditions under which the biocatalyst is stored to maintain its activity and stability.

Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: Enzymatic activity measurement of the biocatalyst.

determination_method.title: determination_method
determination_method.description: Assay method used to measure the enzymatic activity.

unit.title: unit
unit.description: Unit of measurement for the activity (e.g., U/mg, µmol/min/mg).

value.title: value
value.description: Numerical value of the measured activity.

ApplicationWorkflowDetails.title: ApplicationWorkflowDetails
ApplicationWorkflowDetails.description: Specific workflow steps and procedures used when applying the biocatalyst.

cell_disruption_process.title: cell_disruption_process
cell_disruption_process.description: Method used to disrupt cells if working with whole cell preparations.

harvesting_method.title: harvesting_method
harvesting_method.description: Method used to harvest cells or enzyme from the production system.

separation_method.title: separation_method
separation_method.description: Method used to separate the biocatalyst from other components.

source_of_cellfree_extract.title: source_of_cellfree_extract
source_of_cellfree_extract.description: Details about the source and preparation of cell-free extracts if applicable.

BiocatalystApplication.title: BiocatalystApplication
BiocatalystApplication.description: Details about how the biocatalyst is applied and used in the reaction system.

activity.title: activity
activity.description: Measured enzymatic activity of the biocatalyst under the reaction conditions.

application_type.title: application_type
application_type.description: The form in which the biocatalyst is applied (purified enzyme, crude extract, whole cells, etc.).

concentration.title: concentration
concentration.description: Concentration of the biocatalyst in the reaction mixture.

workflow_details.title: workflow_details
workflow_details.description: Specific workflow steps and methods used in applying the biocatalyst.

BiocatalystIdentity.title: BiocatalystIdentity
BiocatalystIdentity.description: Core identifying information and molecular characteristics of the biocatalyst enzyme.

catalyzed_reaction.title: catalyzed_reaction
catalyzed_reaction.description: Description of the specific reaction or type of reaction catalyzed by this enzyme.

ec_number.title: ec_number
ec_number.description: The Enzyme Commission (EC) number that classifies the enzyme according to the reaction it catalyzes.

molecular_weight.title: molecular_weight
molecular_weight.description: The molecular weight of the enzyme in the specified units.

molecular_weight_unit.title: molecular_weight_unit
molecular_weight_unit.description: The unit of measurement for the molecular weight (e.g., kDa, Da).

name.title: name
name.description: The name of the biocatalyst, which can be the trivial name, systematic name, or trade name.

origin_organism.title: origin_organism
origin_organism.description: The organism from which the enzyme was originally derived or isolated.

posttranslational_modification.title: posttranslational_modification
posttranslational_modification.description: Any post-translational modifications present on the enzyme that may affect its activity or properties.

production_organism.title: production_organism
production_organism.description: The organism used to produce the enzyme (may differ from origin organism for recombinant enzymes).

sequences.title: sequences
sequences.description: Amino acid and/or DNA sequence information for the enzyme.

BiocatalystSource.title: BiocatalystSource
BiocatalystSource.description: Information about the source and procurement of the biocatalyst.

purchased_details.title: purchased_details
purchased_details.description: Specific details relevant to commercially purchased biocatalysts.

self_produced_details.title: self_produced_details
self_produced_details.description: Specific details relevant to biocatalysts produced in-house.

source_type.title: source_type
source_type.description: Whether the biocatalyst was purchased from a supplier or produced in-house.

supplier.title: supplier
supplier.description: Name of the commercial supplier or source of the biocatalyst.

Concentration.title: Concentration
Concentration.description: Quantitative information about biocatalyst concentration in the reaction.

determination_method.title: determination_method
determination_method.description: Method used to determine or calculate the concentration.

unit.title: unit
unit.description: Unit of measurement for the concentration (e.g., mg/mL, µM, U/mL).

Immobilization.title: Immobilization
Immobilization.description: Information about biocatalyst immobilization on solid supports.

biocatalyst_state.title: biocatalyst_state
biocatalyst_state.description: Physical state of the biocatalyst during immobilization (e.g., purified enzyme, crude extract).

carrier_material.title: carrier_material
carrier_material.description: Material used as the solid support for immobilization.

immobilisation_chemistry.title: immobilisation_chemistry
immobilisation_chemistry.description: Chemical method or mechanism used for immobilization (e.g., covalent binding, adsorption, entrapment).

immobilisation_method.title: immobilisation_method
immobilisation_method.description: Detailed procedure used for the immobilization process.

immobilized.title: immobilized
immobilized.description: Whether the biocatalyst is immobilized (true) or used in free form (false).

linkers.title: linkers
linkers.description: Chemical linkers or spacers used between the enzyme and carrier material.

loading.title: loading
loading.description: Amount of enzyme loaded onto the carrier material.

notes.title: notes
notes.description: Additional notes about the immobilization process or properties.

purification_method.title: purification_method
purification_method.description: Method used to purify or wash the immobilized biocatalyst.

PurchasedDetails.title: PurchasedDetails
PurchasedDetails.description: Detailed information for commercially purchased biocatalysts.

formulation.title: formulation
formulation.description: Physical form of the purchased biocatalyst (dissolved, powder, etc.).

purity.title: purity
purity.description: Purity of the purchased biocatalyst as specified by the supplier, typically as a percentage.

purity_specification.title: purity_specification
purity_specification.description: Method or specification used to determine the purity (e.g., SDS-PAGE, activity assay).

reference.title: reference
reference.description: Product code, catalog number, or other reference identifier from the supplier.

SelfProducedDetails.title: SelfProducedDetails
SelfProducedDetails.description: Detailed information for biocatalysts produced in-house.

formulation.title: formulation
formulation.description: Physical form of the self-produced biocatalyst after purification and processing.

plasmid_specifications.title: plasmid_specifications
plasmid_specifications.description: Details about the plasmid construction, including vector backbone, promoter, and other relevant features.

purification_method.title: purification_method
purification_method.description: Method(s) used to purify the enzyme after expression.

purity.title: purity
purity.description: Achieved purity of the self-produced biocatalyst, typically as a percentage.

purity_specification.title: purity_specification
purity_specification.description: Method used to determine the purity of the self-produced enzyme.

sequence_plasmid.title: sequence_plasmid
sequence_plasmid.description: Sequence of the plasmid used for enzyme expression.

SequenceInfo.title: SequenceInfo
SequenceInfo.description: Sequence information for the biocatalyst at both the protein and nucleic acid levels.

sequence_amino_acid.title: sequence_amino_acid
sequence_amino_acid.description: The amino acid sequence of the enzyme in single-letter code format.

sequence_dna.title: sequence_dna
sequence_dna.description: The DNA sequence encoding the enzyme.

StorageConditions.title: StorageConditions
StorageConditions.description: Conditions under which materials (biocatalysts, components, etc.) are stored to maintain stability and integrity.

additives.title: additives
additives.description: Any additives or stabilizers used during storage (e.g., glycerol, stabilizers, preservatives).

drying_method.title: drying_method
drying_method.description: Method used to dry the material if stored in dry form (optional, primarily for biocatalysts).

notes.title: notes
notes.description: Additional notes about storage conditions or requirements.

storage_start.title: storage_start
storage_start.description: Date when storage under these conditions began or material was received.

temperature_unit.title: temperature_unit
temperature_unit.description: Unit for the storage temperature (e.g., °C, K).
